Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly analyzed the content of the Theudebert I Wikipedia page. The visible text clearly states: "He was the son of Theuderic I". However, the Planner's analysis falsely claimed that "Theudebert I page confirms Theudebert I is the son of Clovis I." This is a hallucination; Clovis I was the father of Chlothar I, not Theudebert I. This factual error led the Planner to conclude incorrectly that Wisigard's father-in-law was Clovis I instead of the correct answer, Theuderic I.
